description: We are Redx — engineers from robotics, mechatronics, electronics, and AI/ML. We build solutions at the intersection of hardware and data.
summary: Agri Nova is an AI-powered web platform that helps farmers decide what to grow each season and how to rotate crops for long-term soil health. It combines NASA POWER daily and long-term climate data with the farmer’s own soil test. A machine-learning model, 99.6% accurate on records it never saw during training, then ranks the most suitable crops for each season and explains every recommendation. A suitability engine checks each crop against temperature, rainfall, water and soil limits. A rotation planner then builds several strategies and simulates five years of soil carbon, nutrient balance, water demand and climate risk, with downloadable reports for farmers and researchers. This turns NASA Earth observations into practical decisions at the farm level, replacing habit and guesswork with clear, evidence-based guidance. As rainfall grows less predictable, heat rises and soils degrade from repeated cropping, Agri Nova helps farmers, especially smallholders, protect their land, plan their water use and adapt to a changing climate. It’s honest about uncertainty and never invents data.
details:
Agri Nova helps farmers decide what to grow each season and which crop rotation will keep their land healthy. A farmer pins their farm on a map and adds a soil test, and the platform pulls NASA POWER daily and 10-year climate data for that location. A machine-learning model then ranks the best crops for each season and explains each pick. Agri Nova also generates rotation strategies and simulates five years of soil carbon, nutrient balance, water demand and climate risk, with downloadable PDF reports.

Farmers get clear, explained advice instead of guesswork, can plan water use before the season starts, and can compare rotations by what matters to them: soil health, water, climate resilience, income or diversity. Researchers and agricultural organisations get data exports, model details and regional views. The goal is healthier soil, lower risk and more climate-resilient farming, especially for smallholder farmers in India.

We built the frontend with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Leaflet maps, and the backend with Python, FastAPI and PostgreSQL/PostGIS. The AI uses scikit-learn and pandas, PDF reports use ReportLab, and uploaded soil reports are read with Tesseract OCR. The data comes from NASA POWER, with optional GPM IMERG, SMAP, MODIS, HLS, ECOSTRESS and SRTM. No special hardware is needed; it runs in any web browser.

Agri Nova goes beyond picking a single crop: it plans multi-season rotations and simulates how the soil changes year by year. We compared six algorithms, and the chosen model is 99.6% accurate on records it never saw. Every prediction shows its confidence, each crop’s typical conditions, and a warning when inputs are unusual.

Throughout, we focused on accuracy and honesty. The platform never invents data, labels demonstration data clearly, and leaves out yield prediction because our data couldn’t support it. We also kept the language simple for farmers, let them confirm every value read from a soil report, and kept all credentials on the server.
